summary: Context-window meter that fills a pixel strip behind a glowing front, turns amber at 80% and red at 95%, and animates compaction.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled share of the context window in percent, clamped to 0–100. The strip animates to each new level. Use with `onValueChange`.

props.name: capacity
props.description: Window size in tokens, used only for the "used / total" readout, which is shown in thousands.

props.name: label
props.description: Caption before the percentage, and the meter's accessible name.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new percentage when `add()` or `compact()` changes it.

props.name: onCompact
props.description: Called when `compact()` runs, with the percentage before and after.

methods.description: Adds `percent` percentage points (negative to subtract), clamped to 0–100.
Drops usage to 28% of its current value (at least 12%), runs a bright sweep and shows "Compacting…" for 1.5 s. Does nothing at 15% or below.

accessibility: The strip is a canvas with `role="meter"`, `aria-valuemin="0"`, `aria-valuemax="100"`, `aria-valuenow` and an `aria-label` from `label`.
Its `aria-valuetext` reads the level and the token count, for example "46%, 92,000 of 200,000 tokens" (built in English).
There is no live region; changes are not announced.
motion: With reduced motion the fill jumps to the new level, the compaction sweep is skipped, the percentage stops blinking near the limit and text swaps without rolling.
notes: `value` is a percentage, not a token count; the token readout is derived from `capacity`.
The root carries `data-zone` set to `ok`, `warn` (80% and up) or `full` (95% and up), which can be used for styling.
The strip is 18 px tall and fills the available width. Its colours follow the theme and are re-read when it changes.
